subject: Reprioritizing open offers and temporary comp-band hold

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed temporary pause on select offers & comp-band guidance

Team,

With Q1 forecasts tightening and a few larger contracts slipping, I recommend we institute a temporary pause on extending offers for non-critical IC roles while we reallocate headcount to revenue-facing hires.

What I'm proposing:
- Hold offers that are still pending candidate acceptance (Status: verbal intent, no signed offer) for 7 business days.
- Prioritize roles marked "sales" and "platform core" for immediate funding; defer exploratory infra/infra-adjacent reqs.
- Freeze any comp-band exceptions until we have updated salary buckets from Finance (expected by Friday).

Attachments: reqs_Q1_priority_sheet.xlsx (XLSX), offer_template_paused.docx (DOCX)

Ask:
1) Vivek — ok to route 3 headcount slots from infra-exploratory into AE and Solutions Engineer hires? Please confirm what we can immediately reassign.
2) Stephanie — can you hold offer drafts and pause DocuSign sends for candidates in stages "final" and "verbal"? We should avoid ghosting; we'll message candidates through Talent partners.
3) Lauren — will need a short note for candidates if we decide to delay (one-paragraph) — can you draft?

I'll open a brief review window tomorrow at 2pm PT; please respond with your decision and any objections before then.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
